Can you loan me your "Wireshark Style Guide"? :grin:  
  
The thing is a "Attribute Value Pair" (AVP) but the topic is a discussion about them (plural?).  
I don't want `AVPs` to become a 4LA.  
Would it be better to change the header to "Attribute Value Pair"?

I don't know Chuck, but the section goes on to discuss the properties of each AVP in a list of AVPs.  Had hoped to do a more substantial review, but ran out of time and just flushed the single comment I'd made.

Resolved with a Discord messaging discussion.  
Hoping for @jaap to come along and give input or maybe just merged when @AndersBroman does one of his sweeps of waiting merge requests. :-)
